rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a rough, non-final calculation or assessment.

example.english: This estimate should be about right.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu2 gai3 jing1 goi1 caa1 m4 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making a rough calculation or judgment.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 m4 wui5 lei4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a rough numerical calculation or forecast from incomplete data.

example.english: I estimate that it will rain tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for the amount a business or contractor tells you a job is likely to cost, rather than for a general estimate.

example.english: The contractor gave a verbal estimate of thirty thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 裝修師傅口頭報價三萬蚊。
example.jyutping: zong1 sau1 si1 fu6 hau2 tau4 bou3 gaa3 saam1 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the written quotation or document stating the likely cost.

example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gaa3 daan1 ngo5 ji5 ging1 cim1 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically when judging or determining the approximate value or price of something.

example.english: We estimate this flat is worth around five million dollars.
example.traditional: 我哋估價呢間屋值五百萬左右。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gu2 gaa3 ni1 gaan1 uk1 zik6 ng5 baak3 maan6 zo2 jau6
